```{r}
#| include: false
unlink(c("penguins.csv", "cities.tsv", "numbers.txt", "flights.parquet", "shop.duckdb"))

readr::write_csv(
  tidyr::drop_na(palmerpenguins::penguins),
  "penguins.csv"
)

readr::write_tsv(
  data.frame(
    city = c("Amsterdam", "Rotterdam", "Utrecht", "Den Haag"),
    pop = c(921402, 655468, 361924, 552995),
    province = c("Noord-Holland", "Zuid-Holland", "Utrecht", "Zuid-Holland")
  ),
  "cities.tsv"
)

writeLines(c("10", "20", "30", "40", "50"), "numbers.txt")

nanoparquet::write_parquet(
  data.frame(
    carrier = c("UA","AA","DL","UA","AA","DL","UA","AA","DL","WN"),
    origin = c("EWR","JFK","LGA","EWR","JFK","LGA","EWR","JFK","LGA","EWR"),
    dest = c("LAX","SFO","ATL","ORD","LAX","DTW","SFO","MIA","ATL","DEN"),
    dep_delay = c(-2, 5, 12, -1, 120, 3, 0, -4, 22, 45),
    arr_delay = c(-10, -2, 8, 5, 115, -5, -8, -12, 18, 50),
    air_time = c(320, 350, 120, 130, 330, 100, 340, 160, 115, 220),
    distance = c(2454, 2586, 762, 719, 2475, 502, 2565, 1089, 762, 1605)
  ),
  "flights.parquet"
)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(), "shop.duckdb")
DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "customers", data.frame(id = 1:3, name = c("Alice", "Bob", "Carol")))
DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "orders", data.frame(cust = c(1, 1, 2, 3, 3), amount = c(20, 35, 10, 50, 15)))
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```
